**Pack:** `packs/<name>` (folder) / `packs/<name>.json` (own repository)

**What it checks, and for which field:**

**Validation** (how the modules were validated, or "not validated yet"):

**Network / LLM use** (which services, what is sent, why; or "none"):

- [ ] `pytacheck pack check` reports no errors
- [ ] `pack.json` has an OSI-approved licence
- [ ] Tests are included
